title: Jeweled Velvety Moroccan Lentils Harira
description: A peppery and velvety Moroccan dish featuring French lentils, perfect for a date night, served in a dolsot stone bowl. This Buddhist-temple-friendly recipe is a variation of the traditional Harira soup.
instructions: Heat the rendered lardons in a large pot over medium heat until crispy.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the ground cumin and smoked paprika to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the French lentils, tomato paste, and vegetable broth to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the mixture for 30 minutes or until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the pitted dates and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Season the mixture with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the Harira in a dolsot stone bowl and garnish with fresh herbs.
